{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., >75% above recent high) by 15-25% in next 5-7 days.",
    "Adjust downward bias when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., >2 consecutive negative values) by 5-10% in 3-5 day horizon.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates >1.5σ from 30-day moving average, especially after 3-5 days of high volatility.",
    "Increase downward bias if sentiment history includes >1 negative value in last 5 days and forecast is above 70.00.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in low-sentiment periods (sentiment < 0.0) by 30% to avoid overreaction to noise.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast by >10% for 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns positive after 3 negative days, adjust forecast upward by 5-10%."
  ]
}
